source_metadata.title: Discontinuation of statins for primary prevention of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease in adults aged 75 years or older (SAGA/SITE): a multicentre, open-label, pragmatic, non-inferiority randomised trial
source_metadata.authors: Fabrice Bonnet, Pierre Poulizac, Nicolas Rousselot, Thierry Couffinhal, Gaël Galli, Driss Berdaï, Marie-Anne Vandenhende, Marine Rousset, Roxane Coueron, Antoine Bénard, Jean-Philippe Joseph, and The SAGA/SITE Study Group

extraction_limitations: The current schema has no trial-level container; publication metadata and validation are therefore stored in a separate validation report rather than inside each atom.

Supplemental cardiovascular-medication listings were reviewed for SEA context but were not atomized drug-by-drug because they are descriptive co-medication inventory rather than independently load-bearing trial assertions.
Subgroup analyses are individually imprecise; only clinically salient subgroup findings were atomized, while the complete prespecified subgroup panel is preserved in the SEA artifact.
All atoms are marked needs_review because extraction and validation were model-executed rather than human-verified.
